73251-life-in-a-tub-with-a-description-o.title: The Turkish Bath.
73251-life-in-a-tub-with-a-description-o.creator: Διογενης.
73251-life-in-a-tub-with-a-description-o.description: A book by Διογενης.. Perhaps there is nothing more characteristic of the march of intellect of the present day, or more indicative of a healthy tone of mind, than the suspicion with which the public in general, and many physicians in particular, are beginning to regard the use of drugs as curative agents—that chiefest engine of the allopathic physician for the relief of suffering humanity.

arxiv-2104-02052.title: Generating Furry Cars: Disentangling Object Shape & Appearance across Multiple Domains
arxiv-2104-02052.creator: Utkarsh Ojha Krishna Kumar Singh Yong Jae Lee
arxiv-2104-02052.description: Abstract We consider the novel task of learning disentangled representations of object shape and appearance across multiple domains (e.g., dogs and cars). The goal is to learn a generative model that learns an intermediate distribution, which borrows a subset of properties from each domain, enabling the generation of images that did not exist in any domain exclusively.

arxiv-2110-08251.title: Floquet engineering of individual band gaps in an optical lattice using a two-tone drive
arxiv-2110-08251.creator: Kilian Sandholzer, Anne-Sophie Walter, Joaquín Minguzzi, Zijie Zhu, Konrad Viebahn, Tilman Esslinger
arxiv-2110-08251.description: Abstract The dynamic engineering of band structures for ultracold atoms in optical lattices represents an innovative approach to understand and explore the fundamental principles of topological matter. In particular, the folded Floquet spectrum determines the associated band topology via band inversion. We experimentally and theoretically study two-frequency phase modulation to asymmetrically hybridize the lowest two bands of a one-dimensional lattice.

arxiv-2111-08926.title: Vertical structure of Sb-intercalated quasifreestanding graphene on SiC(0001)
arxiv-2111-08926.creator: You-Ron Lin (林 又 容), Susanne Wolff, Philip Schädlich, Mark Hutter, Serguei Soubatch, Tien-Lin Lee (李 天 麟), F. Stefan Tautz, Thomas Seyller, Christian Kumpf, François C. Bocquet
arxiv-2111-08926.description: Abstract Using the normal incidence x-ray standing wave technique as well as low energy electron microscopy we have investigated the structure of quasi-freestanding monolayer graphene (QFMLG) obtained by intercalation of antimony under the ( 6 ​ 3 × 6 ​ 3 ) ​ R ​ 30 ​ ° \left(6\sqrt{3}\times 6\sqrt{3}\right)R$$ reconstructed graphitized 6H-SiC(0001) surface, also known as zeroth-layer graphene.

arxiv-2111-12121.title: Galleries for root subsystems
arxiv-2111-12121.creator: Vladimir Shchigolev
arxiv-2111-12121.description: Abstract . We consider projection and lifting of labelled galleries to and from roots subsystems. Our constructions allow us to construct some topological embeddings of Bott-Samelson varieties skew equivariant with respect to the compact torus and order-preserving on the sets of points fixed by it. 1.

arxiv-2112-15127.title: Towards Automated Sample Collection and Return in Extreme Underwater Environments
arxiv-2112-15127.creator: Gideon Billings, Matthew R. Walter, Oscar Pizarro, Matthew Johnson-Roberson, Richard Camilli
arxiv-2112-15127.description: Abstract In this report, we present the system design, operational strategy, and results of coordinated multi-vehicle field demonstrations of autonomous marine robotic technologies in search-for-life missions within the Pacific shelf margin of Costa Rica and the Santorini-Kolumbo caldera complex, which serve as analogs to environments that may exist in oceans beyond Earth.

arxiv-2205-01679.title: Physics to the Rescue: Deep Non-line-of-sight Reconstruction for High-speed Imaging
arxiv-2205-01679.creator: Fangzhou Mu, Sicheng Mo, Jiayong Peng, Xiaochun Liu, Ji Hyun Nam, Siddeshwar Raghavan, Andreas Velten and Yin Li
arxiv-2205-01679.description: Abstract Computational approach to imaging around the corner, or non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging, is becoming a reality thanks to major advances in imaging hardware and reconstruction algorithms. A recent development towards practical NLOS imaging, Nam et al. [ 1 ] demonstrated a high-speed non-confocal imaging system that operates at 5Hz, 100x faster than the prior art.

arxiv-2211-17176.title: Effect of Boundary Conditions on Second-Order Singularly-Perturbed Phase Transition Models on ℝ \mathbb{R}
arxiv-2211-17176.creator: Thomas Lam
arxiv-2211-17176.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Thomas Lam. The second-order singularly-perturbed problem concerns the integral functional ∫ Ω ε n − 1 ​ W ​ ( u ) + ε n 3 ​ ‖ ∇ 2 u ‖ 2 ​ 𝑑 x \int_{\Omega}\varepsilon_{n}^{-1}W(u)+\varepsilon_{n}^{3}\|\nabla^{2}u\|^{2}\,dx for a bounded open set Ω ⊆ ℝ N \Omega\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{N} , a sequence ε n → 0 + \varepsilon_{n}\to 0^{+} of positive reals, and a function W : ℝ → [ 0 , ∞ ) W:\mathbb{R}\to[0,\infty) with exactly two distinct zeroes.

arxiv-2310-05711.title: Expressive Quantale-Valued Logics for Coalgebras: an Adjunction-Based Approach
arxiv-2310-05711.creator: Harsh Beohar, Sebastian Gurke, Barbara König, Karla Messing, Jonas Forster, Lutz Schröder, Paul Wild
arxiv-2310-05711.description: Abstract We address the task of deriving fixpoint equations from modal logics characterizing behavioural equivalences and metrics (summarized under the term conformances ). We rely on an earlier work that obtains Hennessy-Milner theorems as corollaries to a fixpoint preservation property along Galois connections between suitable lattices.

arxiv-2408-01243.title: Transverse momentum dependence of the T T -even hadronic structure functions in the Drell-Yan process
arxiv-2408-01243.creator: Valery E. Lyubovitskij, Alexey S. Zhevlakov, Iurii A. Anikin
arxiv-2408-01243.description: Abstract We present detailed analysis of the T T -even lepton angular distribution in the Drell-Yan process including γ / Z 0 \gamma/Z^{0} gauge boson exchange and using perturbative QCD based on the collinear factorization scheme at leading order in the α s \alpha_{s} expansion.

arxiv-2501-08327.title: Two-Peak Heat Capacity Accounts for R ln(2) Entropy and Ground State Access in the Dipole-Octupole Pyrochlore Ce 2 Hf 2 O 7
arxiv-2501-08327.creator: E. M. Smith, A. Fitterman, R. Schäfer, B. Placke, A. Woods, S. Lee, S. H.-Y. Huang, J. Beare, S. Sharma, D. Chatterjee, C. Balz, M. B. Stone, A. I. Kolesnikov, A. R. Wildes, E. Kermarrec, G. M. Luke, O. Benton, R. Moessner, R. Movshovich, A. D. Bianchi, B. D. Gaulin
arxiv-2501-08327.description: Abstract Magnetic heat capacity measurements of a high-quality single crystal of the dipole-octupole pyrochlore Ce 2 Hf 2 O 7 down to a temperature of T = 0.02 T=0.02 K are reported. These show a two-peaked structure, with a Schottky-like peak at T 1 ∼ 0.065 T_{1}\sim 0.

arxiv-2504-06791.title: Beware of “Explanations” of AI
arxiv-2504-06791.creator: David Martens, Galit Shmueli, Theodoros Evgeniou, Kevin Bauer, Christian Janiesch, Stefan Feuerriegel, Sebastian Gabel, Sofie Goethals, Travis Greene, Nadja Klein, Mathias Kraus, Niklas Kühl, Claudia Perlich, Wouter Verbeke, Alona Zharova, Patrick Zschech, Foster Provost
arxiv-2504-06791.description: Abstract Understanding the decisions made and actions taken by increasingly complex AI system remains a key challenge. This has led to an expanding field of research in explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), highlighting the potential of explanations to enhance trust, support adoption, and meet regulatory standards.

arxiv-2505-03937.title: Causal Inference in Counterbalanced Within-Subjects Designs
arxiv-2505-03937.creator: Justin Ho, Harvard University
arxiv-2505-03937.description: Abstract Experimental designs are fundamental for estimating causal effects. In some fields, within-subjects designs, which expose participants to both control and treatment at different time periods, are used to address practical and logistical concerns. Counterbalancing, a common technique in within-subjects designs, aims to remove carryover effects by randomizing treatment sequences.

arxiv-2506-20410.title: Beyond Constant-Temperature Reservoirs: A Stirling Cycle with Constant Heat-Generation Rate
arxiv-2506-20410.creator: Xinshu Xia, Hongbo Huang, Hui Dong
arxiv-2506-20410.description: Abstract Conventional heat-engine models typically assume two heat reservoirs at fixed temperatures. In contrast, radioisotope power systems introduce a fundamentally different paradigm in which the hot sources supply heat at a constant generation rate rather than maintaining a constant temperature. We develop a theoretical framework for finite-time heat engines operating between constant heat-generation-rate hot sources and constant-temperature cold reservoirs.

arxiv-2512-08947.title: New Algorithm for Structured OFDM Channel Estimation using Subgroup Duality
arxiv-2512-08947.creator: Demerson N. Gonçalves, João T. Dias
arxiv-2512-08947.description: Abstract This paper presents a group-theoretic framework for structured channel estimation in Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM). By modeling subcarriers as the cyclic group ℤ N \mathbb{Z}_{N} , we show that nulling a subgroup H ⊆ ℤ N H\subseteq\mathbb{Z}_{N} constrains the channel impulse response to its annihilator H ⟂ H^{\perp} in the dual domain.

arxiv-2601-05851.title: Router-Suggest: Dynamic Routing for Multimodal Auto-Completion in Visually-Grounded Dialogs
arxiv-2601-05851.creator: Sandeep Mishra, Devichand Budagam, Anubhab Mandal, Bishal Santra, Pawan Goyal, Manish Gupta
arxiv-2601-05851.description: Abstract Real-time multimodal auto-completion is essential for digital assistants, chatbots, design tools, and healthcare consultations, where user inputs rely on shared visual context. We introduce Multimodal Auto-Completion (MAC), a task that predicts upcoming characters in live chats using partially typed text and visual cues. Unlike traditional text-only auto-completion (TAC), MAC grounds predictions in multimodal context to better capture user intent.

europmc-pmc4827373.title: Stroke injury, cognitive impairment and vascular dementia.
europmc-pmc4827373.creator: Kalaria RN, Akinyemi R, Ihara M.
europmc-pmc4827373.description: The global burden of ischaemic strokes is almost 4-fold greater than haemorrhagic strokes. Current evidence suggests that 25-30% of ischaemic stroke survivors develop immediate or delayed vascular cognitive impairment (VCI) or vascular dementia (VaD). Dementia after stroke...

pmc-10553359.title: Prevalence of HIV testing uptake among the never-married young men (15–24) in sub-Saharan Africa: An analysis of demographic and health survey data (2015–2020)
pmc-10553359.creator: Emmanuel Musonda, Million Phiri, Liness Shasha, Chiti Bwalya, Shuko Musemangezhi, Sage Marie Consolatrice Ishimwe, Chester Kalinda, Ephraim Kumi Senkyire, Ephraim Kumi Senkyire, Ephraim Kumi Senkyire, Ephraim Kumi Senkyire, Ephraim Kumi Senkyire, Ephraim Kumi Senkyire
pmc-10553359.description: BackgroundIn sub-Saharan Africa, HIV and AIDS remain a major public health concern among adolescents and young men. HIV testing is the first critical step for linking infected individuals to HIV treatment and prevention. However, HIV-testing uptake among sexually active young men remains low in the region.

pmc-10555704.title: Lung mechanics showing sex‐based differences and circadian time‐of‐day response to bleomycin‐induced lung injury in mice
pmc-10555704.creator: Chandrashekhar Prasad, Santhosh Kumar Duraisamy, Isaac Kirubakaran Sundar
pmc-10555704.description: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a progressive disease that impairs lung mechanical properties due to dysregulated extracellular matrix remodeling. Lung function assessment is an important physiological endpoint in the mouse model of pulmonary fibrosis (PF) that has gained a broader scientific acceptance in the field. IPF pathophysiology shows sex‐based differences, disproportionately affecting more men compared to women.

pmc-10590945.title: Liver transplantation versus resection for patients with combined hepatocellular cholangiocarcinoma: A retrospective cohort study
pmc-10590945.creator: Shizheng Mi, Ziqi Hou, Guoteng Qiu, Zhaoxing Jin, Qingyun Xie, Jiwei Huang
pmc-10590945.description: BackgroundCombined hepatocellular cholangiocarcinoma (CHC) is a rare primary liver cancer, and whether liver transplantation should be implemented among CHC patients is still controversial. We intend to conduct a retrospective cohort study based on the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) database to investigate the prognosis of liver transplantation vs. liver resection among CHC patients.

pmc-10650801.title: A Non-Canonical Pathway Induced by Externally Applied Virus-Specific dsRNA in Potato Plants
pmc-10650801.creator: Viktoriya O Samarskaya, Nadezhda Spechenkova, Irina Ilina, Tatiana P Suprunova, Natalia O Kalinina, Andrew J Love, Michael E Taliansky, Alexandra S Dubrovina, Konstantin V Kiselev
pmc-10650801.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The external application of double-stranded RNA (dsRNA) has recently been developed as a non-transgenic approach for crop protection against pests and pathogens. This novel and emerging approach has come to prominence due to its safety and environmental benefits. It is generally assumed that the mechanism of dsRNA-mediated antivirus RNA silencing is similar to that of natural RNA interference (RNAi)-based defence against RNA-containing viruses. There is, however, no direct evidence to support this idea.

pmc-10658203.title: Omics-CNN: A comprehensive pipeline for predictive analytics in quantitative omics using one-dimensional convolutional neural networks
pmc-10658203.creator: Anastasia Zompola, Aigli Korfiati, Konstantinos Theofilatos, Seferina Mavroudi
pmc-10658203.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background and objectiveThe development of machine learning-based models that can be used for the prediction of severe diseases has been one of the main concerns of the scientific community. The current study seeks to expand a highly sophisticated tool, the Convolutional Neural Networks, making it applicable in multidimensional omics data classification problems and testing the newly introduced method on publicly available transcriptomics and proteomics data.MethodsIn this study, we introduce Omics-CNN, a Convolutional Neural Network-based pipeline, which couples Convolutional Neural Networks with dimensionality

pmc-11353341.title: Sedentary Behavior, Obesity, and Disabilities in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: Analysis of the Brazilian National Health Survey 2019
pmc-11353341.creator: Bruno Prates Freitas, Letícia Martins Cândido, Katia Jakovljevic Pudla Wagner, Ana Cristina Rodrigues Lacerda, Vanessa Amaral Mendonça, Roberta De Micheli, Alessandro Sartorio, Núbia Carelli Pereira de Avelar, Ana Lúcia Danielewicz, Hiroko Miura
pmc-11353341.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Research suggests that sedentary behavior (SB) and obesity are associated with disabilities in basic activities (BADL) and instrumental (IADL) activities of daily living. However, there is a lack of studies investigating this association in community-dwelling older adults. Thus, the aim of this study was to investigate the association between different SB typologies, isolated and in conjunction with obesity, and their associations with BADL and IADL disabilities in community-dwelling Brazilian older adults.

pmc-11454073.title: 7458 Eight Weeks Intranasal Oxytocin vs. Placebo Does Not Impact Circulating Oxytocin or Arginine-Vasopressin Levels in Adults With Obesity
pmc-11454073.creator: A Aulinas, F Galbiati, M L Wronski, C S Carter, J Davis, H P Nazarloo, K Holman, G Julia, E Asanza, S E Smith, L Kerem, F Plessow, E A Lawson

pmc-11710793.title: A health intervention improves cognition in older adults at risk for Alzheimer’s Disease
pmc-11710793.creator: Michelle Gray, Ray G Urbina, Megan Jones, Anthony Campitelli, Joshua L Gills, Sally Paulson, Jordan M. Glenn
pmc-11710793.description: BackgroundAlzheimer’s disease (AD) is the 7th leading cause of death and 6th most burdensome disease among US older adults. With pharmacological treatments for AD being predominantly ill‐effective, alternative, non‐pharmacological prevention and treatment strategies warrant exploration. Personal health coaching provides individualized strategies designed to improve physical, social, and emotional health leading to positive behavior changes that may improve cognitive ability.

pmc-11714630.title: Establishment of a Practical Risk Assessment Model for Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) in the Elderly
pmc-11714630.creator: Jinlei Li, Gongwu Ding
pmc-11714630.description: BackgroundWith a rapidly aging population, general practitioners (GPs) in communities are confronting the challenge of determining those who are at greatest risk for cognitive impairment and potentially need more specialized follow‐up and intervention to mitigate symptoms early in their course. Mild cognitive impairment (MCI) serves as an important stage for the early intervention and prevention of dementia.

pmc-11715462.title: Effects of a Revision to the Standard Admission Order Set on Laxative Prescribing for Opioid-Induced Constipation
pmc-11715462.creator: Shila Pandey, Jessica I. Goldberg, Kelly Haviland
pmc-11715462.description: Purpose:Opioid-induced constipation (OIC) is highly prevalent in patients with cancer-related pain on opioid analgesics and has negative consequences on physical and psychological well-being and quality of life. Oncology clinical practice guidelines recommend the use of osmotic and stimulant laxatives for the prevention and management of opioid-induced constipation, not stool softeners such as docusate sodium.

pmc-12362661.title: Application and efficacy of quetiapine in patients with high-risk factors for bipolar disorder: A randomized controlled trial
pmc-12362661.creator: Li-Lei Lei, Chen-Jie Ge, Hong Wang, Yu Fang, Lei Zeng, Shi-Liang Wang, Min-Cai Qian
pmc-12362661.description: BACKGROUNDBipolar disorder (BD), marked by recurring manic and depressive episodes, often coexists with anxiety disorder (AD), which increases treatment complexity and morbidity. Although quetiapine, an atypical antipsychotic, has demonstrated efficacy in treating BD and AD, further investigation is needed regarding its effectiveness and safety in patients with AD at high-risk factors for BD.

pmc-12676915.title: Impact of Foot Width on Patient-Reported Outcomes Assessed by 3-Dimensional Foot Morphometry in Hallux Valgus
pmc-12676915.creator: Jungtae Ahn, Dae-Cheol Nam, Gu-Hee Jung
pmc-12676915.description: BackgroundPatients with hallux valgus (HV) deformity often experience shoe-wearing discomfort, and increased foot width is considered a contributing factor. We assessed foot width using standing radiographs and 3-dimensional (3D) scans. This study aims to evaluate how these measurements are related to clinical outcomes in HV patients.MethodsThis cross-sectional study enrolled 19 consecutive adults presenting for hallux valgus evaluation.

pmc-12769570.title: Investigation of road transport-based greenhouse gas prediction models and the use of ıntelligent transportation systems for emission reduction
pmc-12769570.creator: Hande Beba, Zübeyde Öztürk
pmc-12769570.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The study analyzed road transport–related CO₂ emissions in Dilovası, Kocaeli, using artificial intelligence (AI)–based models, highlighting the transportation sector’s major contribution and the need for effective mitigation strategies. Two models, the Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) and the Artificial Neural Network (ANN), were developed using vehicular and meteorological data to predict nitrogen oxide (NOₓ) and carbon monoxide (CO) emissions and were compared with the results of the Calculations of Emissions from Road Transport (COPERT 4) model.

pmc-12993388.title: Espirometría y tabaquismo en atención primaria: una oportunidad clínica más allá del tratamiento
pmc-12993388.creator: Antoni Santigosa-Ayala, María del Mar Rodríguez-Álvarez, Francisco M Martín-Luján
pmc-12993388.description: EMFYC, en la que se difundieron diversos mensajes clave sobre este tema1. Entre ellos, la recomendación de identificar de forma proactiva a las personas fumadoras y ofrecerles ayuda para el abandono del hábito mediante consejo breve en cada contacto clínico. Este planteamiento es ampliamente compartido y coherente con las recomendaciones actuales.

pmc-13044966.title: Combined analysis of host immune response, biofilm genes, and 16S rRNA detection in fracture-related infection: an observational cohort study
pmc-13044966.creator: Melissa Depypere, Jonathan Sliepen, Jolien Onsea, Yves Debaveye, T. Fintan Moriarty, Elena Della Bella, Emmanuel André, Johan Van Weyenbergh, Willem-Jan Metsemakers
pmc-13044966.description: Fracture-related infection (FRI) is a serious complication in orthopaedic trauma that can lead to delayed union, nonunion, and poor clinical outcomes. A better understanding of the host immune response may provide valuable insights into the pathophysiology of FRI and may help identify genomic elements that contribute to the infection.

pmc-13296497.title: The Value of Reversible Carbon Storage in a Zero-Emissions World
pmc-13296497.creator: Allegra C. Mayer, Jerome Dumortier, Zeke Hausfather, Jennifer Pett-Ridge, Eric W. Slessarev
pmc-13296497.description: Atmospheric carbon dioxide removal (CDR) is required to stabilize global temperature. CDR can be achieved via ecosystem-based approaches that are cost-effective but reversible (e.g., soil and forest management) or by more durable but expensive approaches (e.g., direct air capture coupled with geologic storage). Here, we examine trade-offs between these approaches, focusing on timing, climate impacts, and cost.

pmc-13325580.title: Pulmonary infectious complications associated with the addition of cryobiopsy to conventional sampling for peripheral pulmonary lesions: a retrospective study
pmc-13325580.creator: Tatsuya Imabayashi, Yuji Matsumoto, Keigo Uchimura, Hideaki Furuse, Takaaki Tsuchida
pmc-13325580.description: BackgroundCryobiopsy is used in addition to conventional sampling during endobronchial ultrasound (rEBUS)-guided bronchoscopy for peripheral pulmonary lesions (PPLs) to improve diagnostic yield. However, the incremental risk of procedure-related pulmonary infection remains poorly quantified in routine clinical practice.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed consecutive patients who underwent rEBUS-guided bronchoscopy for PPLs between January 2019 and March 2022.

pmc-13358687.title: Not only reseeder or resprouter plants: Trait syndromes and post‐fire responses of three iconic Mediterranean woody species
pmc-13358687.creator: G. Ottaviani, H. Beckett, J. M. Costa‐Saura, E. Agrillo, G. Bonari, C. Calfapietra, E. D'Andrea, P. Fiorucci, M. Lo Cascio, M. Magnani, S. Portarena, C. Sirca, M. Baudena, M. Millan
pmc-13358687.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Fire can profoundly affect ecosystem dynamics, species distribution and plant traits, especially in open biomes. Post‐fire strategies, namely, resprouters and reseeders, offer a useful framework to examine eco‐evolutionary relationships between plants and fire. However, whether resprouter and reseeder plants are consistently formed by distinct trait coordination (syndromes) and responses to fire at the intraspecific level and when considering the role of ontogeny, remain underexplored.

pmc-13416460.title: The partner gene modulates response to asciminib in ABL1-rearranged Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
pmc-13416460.creator: Laura N Eadie, Daniel P McDougal, Elias Lagonik, Caitlin E Schutz, Elyse C Page, Tace S Conlin, Jacqueline Rehn, John B Bruning, Andrew S Moore, David T Yeung, Timothy P Hughes, Deborah L White
pmc-13416460.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13434334.title: MiaA-mediated tRNA modifications couple tryptophan attenuation and changes in tRNA abundance to complex phenotypes in Pseudomonas aeruginosa
pmc-13434334.creator: Yannick N Frommeyer, Janne G Thöming, Nicolas O Gomez, Svenja Grobe, Matthias Preusse, Alejandro Arce-Rodríguez, Kerstin Neubauer, Benedikt Kennepohl, Tim Kirk, Raimo Franke, Mark Brönstrup, Meina Neumann-Schaal, Mathias Müsken, Daniel P Depledge, Heike Bähre, Andreas Pich, Susanne Häussler
pmc-13434334.description: Transfer RNA (tRNA)-modifying enzymes are emerging as key regulators of bacterial physiology. MiaA, a tRNA isopentenyltransferase, is well studied in model organisms, but its role in the opportunistic pathogen Pseudomonas aeruginosa remains unclear. Using LC–MS, nanopore tRNA sequencing, as well as transcriptional, translational, and proteomic profiling, we mapped MiaA-dependent tRNA modifications and revealed unexpected effects of MiaA loss.

pmc-13609310.title: Diterpenes with Abietane and Clerodane Skeletons from the Mexican Salvia Species as Potential Bioactive Compounds
pmc-13609310.creator: Nancy Ortiz-Mendoza, Iván J. Bazany-Rodríguez, Martha J. Martínez-Gordillo, Francisco A. Basurto-Peña, Alejandro Dorazco-González, Itzi Fragoso-Martínez, María Eva González-Trujano, Emmanuel Martínez Ambriz, Marcos Soto-Hernández, Eva Aguirre-Hernández
pmc-13609310.description: Salvia (Lamiaceae) is Mexico’s most diverse and widely distributed genus. It represents an important natural resource for the country, with approximately 310 species belonging to the subgenera Calosphace, Audibertia, and Heterosphace. Several of these species have been used in traditional Mexican medicine to treat various diseases. However, the main secondary metabolites as potential bioactive components have been poorly described.

(b) Assessors. NVLAP shall select qualified.

uslaw-cfr-t20-s30-412.title: 20 C.F.R. § 30.412 — Who pays for second opinion and referee examinations?
uslaw-cfr-t20-s30-412.creator: Office Of Workers' Compensation Programs, Department Of Labor

OWCP will also reimburse the employee for all necessary and reasonable expenses incident to such an examination, including transportation.
